turn.prompt: [Image #7] Can we improve the screenshot handling? For example, in this case, it has some screenshots. Can we have them make them clickable or show a small inline thumbnail or something like that? That would really make the user experience much better than using the Claude Agent.
turn.final_text:
Screenshots no longer stay in memory once they scroll by. That's in build cabf31d at https://devbox.example.ts.net:8443/, together with fixes for the four problems from the last Codex review.

**Memory clean-up:**
- When an image path scrolls off screen, Sidra drops that image from memory.
- Scrolling back up fetches it again from the Mac or VM.
- An image that finishes downloading after its path has already scrolled away is thrown out at once.
- An image already open in the full-size viewer stays until you close the viewer.

**Codex review fixes:**
- **Narrow windows:** the keyboard now switches to a phone-style layout below 520 pt wide, so letter keys stay about 26 pt wide:
  - numbers, then q–p, then a–l with a plain return key, then ⇧ z–m ⌫, then ctrl, alt, hide, space and the arrows;
  - tab, the paste key and the punctuation moved into the top row, which scrolls sideways.

  To check it in the Simulator I forced this layout on for one test run. Typing and swiping still pass, and the screenshot looks right. I haven't seen it in a real narrow window yet.
- **Thumbnails that failed to load:** if the file wasn't there yet when the path first appeared, Sidra tries again after 15 seconds.
- **Image paste with the SwiftTerm engine:** if you moved to another pane during the upload, the path now goes to the clipboard instead of into the old pane, as it already did with the default engine.
- **Symbol key text colour:** it now uses the app's shared colour value instead of a hard-coded copy, so it looks the same.

The terminal tests and the thumbnail UI test pass after these changes. On the iPad I haven't yet tried thumbnails or link taps in herdr.
